== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original [[Death Star Tractor Beam]] and [[Death Star Tractor Beam (Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0). Appendix A matches, so same-words PC Errata / PC Errata 2 / PC Errata 3 fold into Decipher Errata. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata (omit missing). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
